summary: Backend + frontend testing for AMASS landing refresh (fixa_provider lead form, dual applications, FIXA section, pillars, hero legend, footer legal/contact dialogs, mobile). Backend: 16/16 pytest cases pass including new fixa_provider lead creation, become_agent regression, invalid form_type -> 400, admin stats/filter/CMS/reset. Frontend: all requested data-testids present and functional; no console errors; mobile 390px has no horizontal overflow; theme toggle works; both application dialogs show the approval chip; legal and contact dialogs open from footer.
critical_code_review_comments: No rate limiting on public /api/leads /api/newsletter — spam vector; add throttling or captcha.
VALID_FORMS is a flat set; consider mapping form_type to allowed required-field validators (e.g. require name for applications, phone optional, etc.) for stronger server-side validation.
CORS allow_origins defaults to '*' with allow_credentials=True — browsers will reject credentialed requests. Acceptable for key-based machine traffic but worth documenting.
seed_data_creation: A few TEST_ leads (fixa_provider, become_agent, contact) and newsletter signups created during tests. Content was reset via /api/admin/content/reset after CMS tests.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend fixa_provider path verified end-to-end (POST->admin list). Frontend uses Lenis + framer-motion whileInView — remember to scroll elements into view before clicking (we did this for fixa-section, agents-cta, footer links). Logo at /amass-logo.png, FIXA PRO at /fixa-pro.png. Legal dialog is a single component reused for Privacy/Terms with data-testid=legal-dialog.
